name.fr-FR: Dieu, son existence et sa nature (traduction anglaise)
name.en-US: God: His Existence and His Nature
name.pt-BR: Deus, sua existência e sua natureza (tradução inglesa)

description.en-US: Thomistic natural theology in two volumes: the existence of God and His nature and attributes, with the antinomies of agnosticism. Dom Bede Rose’s translation of the fifth French edition (Herder, 1934-36), with the author’s prefaces and appendices.
description.pt-BR: Teodiceia tomista em dois volumes: a existência de Deus e sua natureza e atributos. Tradução de Dom Bede Rose da quinta edição francesa (Herder, 1934-36).

sources.edition: God: His Existence and His Nature, tr. Dom Bede Rose, 2 vols, St. Louis: B. Herder, 1934-36 (from the 5th French edition); the index is not imported
